ktk.text: Taigam, a monk trained by Narset, left the Jeskai and traveled to Purugir seeking work, where the rakshasa Ebirri offered him power and Taigam pledged his life to the rakshasa.
He rose to chief advisor of Sidisi, who sent him to enforce her decrees, and he arrived at Kishla on a golden ship pulled by undead sibsig to collect the town's debt.
There he humiliated an elder and had a guard take one of his three children, until Jeskai monks burst into the ship to assassinate him, and Ebirri killed two while reminding Taigam that he owns him.
Taigam learned that Narset had sent the surviving monk, had him crushed, suspected the monks were zealots acting without her, and resolved to handle the Jeskai threat himself.
